content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SBI has notified a total of 35 vacancies for the Trade Finance Officer - IBG post across two grades.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on 31.07.2026. The maximum age limit applies to Unreserved category candidates; relaxation is available to reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines. Cumulative age relaxation is not available either among the above categories or in combination with any other relaxation. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly. Mandatory (both posts): Graduate (any discipline) from a Government-recognized University or Institution, and Certification in Forex Operations from IIBF. The certificate must be dated on or before 31.07.2026. Preferred: Certificate for Documentary Credit Specialists (CDCS) by LIBF, or Certificate for Specialists in Demand Guarantees (CSDG) by LIBF, or Certified Trade Finance Professional (CTFP) by ICC Academy - OR - Global Trade Certificate (GTC) by ICC Academy, Certificate in International Trade Finance (CITF) by LIBF, or Certificate in International Trade Finance (IIBF). These preferred certificates should also be dated on or before 31.07.2026. Teaching and training experience will not be counted for eligibility. The relevant experience certificate from the employer must specifically state the candidate's experience in the required field.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected officials will be eligible for Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), Provident Fund, Contributory Pension Fund (NPS), Leave Fare Concession (LFC), medical facility, and other perquisites as per rules in force from time to time. JMGS-I (Maker role): Inputs trade transactions and uploads documents into banking systems, handles TI+ data entry, conducts document scrutiny before approval, and inputs screening data into relevant systems. MMGS-II (Checker role): Conducts TI+ checking to validate transactions, performs document scrutiny, facilitates screening against sanctions and AML policies, validates regulatory compliance, and acts as an OFAC releaser. Both roles require working in rotational shifts, which may be subject to change as per the Bank's requirements.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fees can be paid online through Internet Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card via the payment gateway integrated with the application. The application fee, once paid, is not refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Trade Finance Officer - IBG post will be made on the basis of Shortlisting and Interview. Shortlisting: Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The shortlisting committee will decide the parameters, and an adequate number of candidates will be shortlisted. Interview: The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. Merit List: The final merit list will be prepared in descending order based on interview scores. In case of a tie at the cut-off, candidates will be ranked by age in descending order. The call letter/intimation for interview will be sent by email or uploaded on the Bank's website; no hard copy will be sent.

faq.question: Q1. What is SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SBI TFO Recruitment 2026 refers to the recruitment of Trade Finance Officer – IBG (TFO-IBG) at JMGS-I and MMGS-II grades by State Bank of India under Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/15.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 35 vacancies are available - 14 for TFO-IBG JMGS-I and 21 for TFO-IBG MMGS-II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and payment of fees is 19.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate (any discipline) from a Government-recognized University or Institution and hold a Certification in Forex Operations from IIBF, dated on or before 31.07.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For JMGS-I, the age limit is 21 to 30 years; for MMGS-II, it is 23 to 32 years, as on 31.07.2026. Age relaxation applies to reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 750/- for General/EWS/OBC candidates. There is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SBI TFO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official SBI careers website at sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings by registering, filling the application form, uploading required documents, and paying the applicable fee.
